conjunctive_law.comparator_first_pinning: Zero-shot comparators (B_0, Qwen3.8-27B, Goedel-Prover-V2-8B) are evaluated and SHA-256 pinned BEFORE reserving HOLDOUT_SEAL_*.json (O_CREAT | O_EXCL + fsync on local NVMe) or evaluating any promoted A* candidate.
conjunctive_law.holdout_conjunctive_inference: Both item-pooled (N=200) and equal_stratum (4 x 1/4) stratified Rademacher sign-flip permutation p_one_sided must pass Holm-Bonferroni across all promoted models in the track.
conjunctive_law.holm_bonferroni_indexing: 0-based step-down alpha / (K - rank_0) across ALL K tested challengers in track, stopping at first non-rejection.
conjunctive_law.math500_retention_role: Evaluated outside the 4-contest average (N=150, mean@8 per item) as a non-degradation retention check.
conjunctive_law.rule: v3.6 can ONLY veto a v2 Confirmation PROMOTE, never rescue a v2 ROLLBACK.
conjunctive_law.unpromoted_holdout_policy: Any challenger failing Confirmation retains B_0 and is NEVER evaluated on Protected Holdout.
